name: Satyr Slaying!
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana calls Alliance champions against Ashenvale's satyrs. She grieves for her sister Anilia and asks you to bring back satyr horns as proof.

sections.title: A Dryad's Grief
sections.body: Anilia's death has left Illiyana grieving at the Shrine of Aessina. Dryads are forest spirits bound to nature, often playful and serene, yet elusive to mortals. Anilia's brutal slaying shattered that calm. Now Illiyana calls on Alliance travelers to strike down the demonic beasts responsible.

sections.title: The Corrupted Kin
sections.body: Once night elves, the satyrs were corrupted by demonic energy during the War of the Ancients. They lurk in defiled groves across Ashenvale and prey on the woods' inhabitants as servants of the Burning Legion. Their horns prove vengeance to Illiyana and mark a strike against the fel presence encroaching on eastern Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Illiyana is a dryad who lives at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. Gentle by nature, she mourns her sister Anilia, slain by local satyrs.
Anilia was a dryad and Illiyana's beloved sister. They spent ages beneath Ashenvale's ancient canopies until satyrs ambushed and killed Anilia.

faq.q: Why does Illiyana ask for satyr horns?
faq.answer: Illiyana asks for satyr horns as proof that the creatures who killed Anilia have been slain. She hopes the proof will bring her sister's spirit peace.

aliases: what are the satyrs in ashenvale
faq.answer: Satyrs are night elves corrupted and changed by the Burning Legion's demonic powers during the War of the Ancients. They dwell in corrupted enclaves, spreading taint and destroying forest spirits.
Forest Song is an ancient, nearly abandoned night elf ruin in far eastern Ashenvale, near the border of Azshara. Illiyana waits at the Shrine of Aessina, not at Forest Song.

faq.q: Is this connected to any other hunts?
faq.answer: Illiyana continues to accept satyr horns after Anilia is avenged. Ashenvale's defenders still work to drive the satyrs from the forest.

angles.text: As a druid, you strike at corruption in Cenarius's favored wilderness by avenging a fallen dryad and taking the horns of demonic satyrs.
As a night elf, you know satyrs as a shameful reminder of the Highborne's ancient fall into fel servitude. You help cleanse the land of this ancestral blight.
As an Alliance champion, you thin the satyr ranks and make Ashenvale's forest safer from the wild threats around you.
